values.name: __criteria_mapping__
values.description: Which evidence reference supports which criterion.

values.name: __coverage_scoring__
values.description: Per-criterion coverage verdict plus the category rollup.

values.name: __attestation_id__
values.description: Deterministic id of the emitted readiness attestation.

values.name: __workflow_id__
values.description: Runtime-supplied: content-model slug of the workflow that ran.

values.name: __owner_role__
values.description: Role-shaped owner of the readiness posture; a role, never a person.

values.name: __crosswalk_entries__
values.description: The SOC 2 crosswalk entries to score against, read from content/mappings/soc2/*.yaml by the adapter. Passed in as data so the criteria set is not hard-coded in this playbook.

nodes.name: collect criteria atoms
nodes.notes: Read the Trust Services Criteria crosswalk under content/mappings/soc2/ into per-criterion atoms. The criteria set is data, not a constant in this playbook, so a criterion added to the crosswalk is scored on the next run without a content change here.

nodes.name: map evidence to criteria
nodes.notes: Join the evidence references available for the window onto the criteria they support. An evidence reference naming a criterion the crosswalk does not carry is reported as unmatched rather than silently dropped.

nodes.name: score per-criterion coverage
nodes.notes: Score each criterion as covered, partially covered or uncovered, and roll the result up per Trust Services category. Coverage resting on a draft mapping is counted separately — a draft crosswalk entry is not audit-ready evidence.

nodes.name: report readiness attestation

nodes.notes: Emit one dated readiness attestation naming covered, partially covered and uncovered criteria, the draft-backed subset, and the owner. It is readiness input for an auditor, never an audit opinion.

parameters.content:
## SOC 2 evidence collector
`playbook.soc2_evidence_collector@v1` · content v1.0.0 · maturity: stable · compiled from a CACAO 2.0 playbook by SecOps-NG

Aggregates the evidence the operator's other playbooks already emit into a dated SOC 2 readiness attestation. Reads the Trust Services Criteria crosswalk under content/mappings/soc2/, maps each available evidence reference onto the criteria it supports, scores per-criterion coverage, and reports one attestation naming what is covered, what is uncovered, and what rests on draft mappings. It collects no new telemetry and asserts no audit opinion — SOC 2 attestation is a licens…

**Regulatory anchors**
- docs/cookbook/soc2_crosswalk.md — SOC 2 is not an EU statutory instrument; the EU mappings remain the authoritative statutory pointer

**Controls:** 1 control reference(s) in the canonical source, mapped under `content/mappings/`.

**Before you run it**
- Inputs the trigger expects from you: `__assessment_window__`, `__evidence_refs__`, `__workflow_id__`, `__execution_id__`, `__captured_at__`, `__owner_role__`, `__crosswalk_entries__`
- Code nodes name the deterministic primitive each step runs; bind them to where your primitives execute, or replace the body:
  - collect criteria atoms → `content.playbooks.soc2_evidence_collector.primitives.criteria.collect_criteria_atoms`
  - map evidence to criteria → `content.playbooks.soc2_evidence_collector.primitives.mapping.map_evidence_to_criteria`
  - score per-criterion coverage → `content.playbooks.soc2_evidence_collector.primitives.scoring.score_criterion_coverage`
  - report readiness attestation → `content.playbooks.soc2_evidence_collector.primitives.attestation.build_readiness_attestation`
- This file carries no credentials; connectors and secrets are yours to attach.

**Source** https://github.com/secops-ng/secops-ng-framework/tree/main/content/playbooks/soc2_evidence_collector
